- Roar button

Prioritize in this order:

1. Generate a good T-Rex mesh
2. Rig the complete dinosaur correctly
3. Create all required animations
4. Connect animations to player controls
5. Build the small test environment
6. Test movement, animation transitions, collisions, and mobile controls

Do not replace the animated T-Rex with a basic Roblox character or an unrigged static model.
